# telnyx_messaging_profile_alphanumeric_sender_ids (Data Source)

Lists the alphanumeric sender IDs registered on a messaging profile.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `messaging_profile_id` (String) The messaging profile id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `messaging_profile_alphanumeric_sender_ids` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messaging_profile_alphanumeric_sender_ids))

<a id="nestedatt--messaging_profile_alphanumeric_sender_ids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `messaging_profile_alphanumeric_sender_ids`

Read-Only:

- `alphanumeric_sender_id` (String) The alphanumeric sender ID string.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the alphanumeric sender ID resource.
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) The messaging profile this sender ID belongs to.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization that owns this sender ID.
- `record_type` (String)
- `us_long_code_fallback` (String) A US long code number to use as fallback when sending to US destinations.
